transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

Hi, doctor. Um, thanks for seeing me. I, uh... well, I guess my manager and some of my teachers thought it would be a good idea for me to come in. I hope that's okay? 

I've just been... well, I've been doing some things lately that I guess don't make a lot of sense to other people. It's nothing really bad, I promise! Just, um, little habits, I suppose. Like at work—I'm an accounting clerk—I've been sort of lining up the receipts across the floor instead of putting them in the files right away. And I've been tapping the calculator in sets of nine. It just... feels right, you know? And sometimes I'll just stand by the copier with my hands held up for a while, just until someone asks if I'm okay. I know it sounds a little silly when I say it out loud. Does that make sense? I really don't mean to cause any trouble or anything.
Do you think these behaviors are excessive or unreasonable?

Oh, um... well, I wouldn't really call them excessive, exactly. I mean, I still get all my bookkeeping done on time, I promise. It just... it just takes a few extra seconds to do the tapping, that's all. 

I really hope it doesn't make me seem, you know, difficult to work with or anything like that. It just feels like a little routine to help me get through the day. I mean, do you think it sounds unreasonable? I definitely don't want to be doing anything wrong, I just... I didn't think it was hurting anyone. Is that alright?
Do these routines feel unwanted or intrusive to you?

Um, no, not really. I wouldn't say they're unwanted. Honestly, they... they actually feel kind of comforting to me. I don't mind doing them at all. 

They don't pop into my head and bother me or anything like that, if that's what you mean. It's more just... something I do naturally. I hope that doesn't sound too strange? It's really only when my manager pointed it out that I started worrying about it. I mean, I definitely don't want to be a distraction to anyone else in the office. But to me, personally, no, they aren't intrusive. Is it okay that they don't bother me?
Do you ever get unwanted thoughts or images that make you feel anxious and lead you to do these routines?

Um, no, I don't think so. I don't really get anything like that. No bad images or scary thoughts or anything. I just... I just do the things because they feel right, not because I'm anxious or anything. 

I mean, I hope that's the right answer? I'm not trying to hide anything, I promise. I just don't really feel anxious about it. It's just a normal part of my day. Is that what you were looking for? I want to make sure I'm giving you the right information.
When you don’t do one of these routines, do you feel anxious or uncomfortable until you do it?

Um, well, I wouldn't say anxious, really. If I miss doing it, I just... I might notice it, but it doesn't make me feel bad or uncomfortable or anything. I can just keep working. 

I really try to make sure my work comes first, you know? So if I can't tap the desk right then, it's totally fine. I don't get upset. I hope that's a good thing? I definitely wouldn't want it to seem like I can't control myself or that it's getting in the way of my job. I'm doing okay, right?
Do you feel these routines are senseless or pointless?

Um, well... I guess maybe they do seem a little pointless to other people? I mean, that's actually kind of why I came in to see you. I've started doing these things at work and, um, at school that... well, I admit they probably don't make a lot of sense. 

Like, sometimes I'll line up all the receipts across the floor, or I'll tap my calculator in sets of nine. And... well, sometimes I'll just stand by the copier with my hands held up in the air, and I just stay like that until someone comes over and asks if I'm okay. 

I know that probably sounds really silly, doesn't it? I really don't want to be a bother to anyone at the office with it. I hope it's okay that I'm telling you this? I just want to make sure I'm answering your questions right... I don't want you to think I'm completely weird or anything for doing it. That's exactly the kind of thing you were asking about, right?
Do you believe these routines are actually reasonable, or do you see them as unreasonable?

Um, I mean, I guess I know they're not exactly reasonable. Like, I know it doesn't make sense to stand by the copier like that, or to line up the receipts. I'm not... I'm not delusional or anything like that, I promise. 

I just, well, I know it's a little unusual, but it's not hurting anyone, right? I try to be really careful not to let it get in the way of my bookkeeping work. I know it's unreasonable when I really think about it, but in the moment, it just kind of happens. 

Is that what you mean? I hope I'm not making it sound worse than it is. I really am trying to be reasonable about the whole thing. Does that make sense?
What do you think would happen if you didn’t do one of these routines?

Um, nothing bad, I don't think. Like I said, I don't get anxious or anything if I don't do them. I guess... I guess nothing would really happen at all. 

I just kind of do them because... well, I'm not even really sure why, to be honest. But it's not like I think the world is going to end or I'll get fired if I don't tap the calculator, you know? I know that would sound really crazy. 

So, yeah, nothing happens if I skip them. I can totally stop if I need to. That's a good sign, isn't it? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right idea about all this.
Do you get any sense of pleasure or satisfaction from doing these routines?

Um, no, not really. I don't get any sort of... thrill out of it or anything like that. It's definitely not like a hobby or something I do for fun. 

I guess maybe it's just... I don't know, a habit? But it's not something I look forward to doing, I promise. I don't want you to think I'm enjoying acting weird at work. I know I need to be professional. 

I'm really trying to give you the best answers I can. Does that sound like what you were looking for? I hope I'm being helpful.
Do you feel like you have to do these routines until they feel 'just right' or balanced?

No, I don't think so. It's not like I'm standing there trying to get it perfect or anything. I'm not... obsessed with it. 

I just kind of do it and then move on. It's really quick, I promise. I don't let it take up time that I should be spending on the accounts. I know I have to be efficient. 

I don't have to do it until it feels a certain way. I just do it and that's it. Is that... is that a good thing? I hope that means it's not as bad as it sounds. I'm really trying to make sure I'm doing everything right here.
Do you ever have unwanted, intrusive thoughts or images that keep coming back and bother you?

Um, no, I don't think so. I don't really get bad thoughts or... pictures stuck in my head. My mind is usually pretty clear, especially when I'm at work doing the books. I just try to focus on what I'm supposed to be doing. 

I don't have things popping up that bother me or scare me or anything like that. I would definitely tell you if I did, I promise. I really want to make sure I'm giving you all the right information so you can help me. 

Is it... is it okay that I don't have those? I mean, I hope that's a good sign, right?
About how much time do these routines take you each day?

Um, honestly, hardly any time at all. It's really fast. I'd say maybe... just a few minutes total out of the whole day? 

It definitely doesn't interfere with my work, I promise. I know how important it is to keep up with the auditing and make sure everything is accurate. I wouldn't let anything get in the way of that. 

It's just a quick little thing I do, and then I'm right back to the books. I hope that's okay? I mean, a few minutes isn't too bad, is it? I really don't want you to think it's this big, disruptive thing.
